record.title: Inverting functions in the Drury–Arveson space for dimension 5
record.statement: Let $H^2_5$ be the Drury–Arveson space of analytic functions on the unit ball $B_5\subset\mathbb{C}^5$ such that, for $f(z)=\sum_{n\in\mathbb{N}^5}a_nz^n$, $\|f\|_{H^2_5}^2=\sum_{n\in\mathbb{N}^5}|a_n|^2\frac{n!}{|n|!}<\infty$, where $|n|=n_1+\cdots+n_5$ and $n!=n_1!\cdots n_5!$. If $f\in H^2_5$ and $|f(z)|\ge 1$ for every $z\in B_5$, must $1/f\in H^2_5$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/49](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4531), page 61. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Boundary terms for vanishing-viscosity stochastic perturbations
record.statement: The bulk part $J^0$ of the dynamic functional ([17]) governs large deviations for a vanishing-viscosity stochastic perturbation of equation (2). Can one add boundary conditions to this stochastic equation and obtain the boundary terms for the dynamic large deviations?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/50](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4532), page 45. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Monotonicity of the diffusion coefficient in the particle density
record.statement: For every fixed \b3>0, the diffusion coefficient $D_\b3(\d70)$ is decreasing as a function of the density $\d70$ on $[0,1]$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/50](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4532), page 55. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Homotopy groups of rapidly decreasing mapping groups
record.statement:
Let $m$ be a positive integer and let $H$ be a Lie group modelled on a locally convex space. For every $k=1,2,\ldots$, the homotopy groups satisfy

$$\pi_k\bigl(S(\mathbb{R}^m,H)\bigr)=\pi_{k+m}(H).$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/51](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4533), page 62. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Ext-groups for affine Hecke algebras and their Schwartz completions
record.statement:
Let $H$ be an affine Hecke algebra with positive parameters, let $\[200m\pi,\[0m\pi'$ be finite-dimensional tempered $H$-modules, and let $S$ be the Schwartz completion of $H$. Then, for every $i\in\mathbb{Z}$, there is an isomorphism
$$
\operatorname{Ext}^{i}_{H}(\pi,\pi')\simeq \operatorname{Ext}^{i}_{S}(\pi,\pi').
$$
Consequently, $EP_H(\pi,\pi')=EP_S(\pi,\pi')$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/52](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4534), page 26. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Vanishing of the simplicial volume of the moduli space of closed Riemann surfaces
record.statement: For every integer $g\ge 1$, the simplicial volume of the moduli space $\mathcal{M}_g$ is equal to $0$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4535), page 17. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Non-varying sum of Lyapunov exponents in hyperelliptic strata
record.statement: For all hyperelliptic strata, the sum of Lyapunov exponents is non-varying.

record.title: Nielsen realization problem for finite quasiconformal mapping class subgroups
record.statement: Let $R$ be a Riemann surface admitting a hyperbolic structure, let $\operatorname{MCG}(R)$ be its quasiconformal mapping class group, and let $q:\operatorname{QC}(R)\to\operatorname{MCG}(R)$ be the natural surjection. For every finite subgroup $\Gamma\leq\operatorname{MCG}(R)$, there exists a homomorphism $E:\Gamma\to\operatorname{QC}(R)$ such that $q\circ E=\operatorname{id}_{\Gamma}$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4535), page 26. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Andreadakis conjecture for the automorphism group of a free group
record.statement:
Let $F_n$ be a free group of rank $n\ge 2$, let $IA_n=A'_n(1)$ be its IA-automorphism group, let $A'_n(1),A'_n(2),\ldots$ be the lower central series of $IA_n$, and let $A_n(1),A_n(2),\ldots$ be the Johnson filtration of $\operatorname{Aut}F_n$. The Andreadakis conjecture asks whether
\[
A'_n(k)=A_n(k)
\]
for every $k\ge 1$ (for each $n\ge 2$).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4535), page 59. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Strict positivity for the fourth-order quantum diffusion equation
record.statement:
For the fourth-order quantum diffusion equation

$$
\partial_t n+\operatorname{div}\!\left(n\nabla\left(\frac{\Delta\sqrt n}{\sqrt n}\right)\right)=0,
\qquad n(\cdot,0)=n_0\ge 0\ \text{in }\mathbb T^d,
$$

is the solution strictly positive for every $t>0$, even if the nonnegative initial datum vanishes at some point?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/54](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4536), page 37. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Simonovits–Sidorenko conjecture
record.statement: For every bipartite graph $F$, the functional $t(F,W)-t(K_2,W)^{|E(F)|}$ is minimized by constant functions $W$, where $W$ ranges over graphons.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4791), page 4. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Local out-neighbour chromatic number versus global tournament chromatic number
record.statement: For all $k \ge 0$ there exists $c$ such that, if $G$ is a tournament in which the set of out-neighbours of each vertex has chromatic number at most $k$, then $\chi(G) \le c$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4791), page 23. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Vertex-disjoint directed paths in semicomplete digraphs
record.statement: For every fixed integer $k$, there is a polynomial-time algorithm that, given a semicomplete digraph $G$, vertices $s_1,t_1,\ldots,s_k,t_k$ of $G$, and integers $x_1,\ldots,x_k\ge 0$, decides whether there exist pairwise vertex-disjoint directed paths $P_1,\ldots,P_k$ in $G$ such that, for each $1\le i\le k$, $P_i$ is a path from $s_i$ to $t_i$ having at most $x_i$ vertices.

record.title: Forcing conjecture for bipartite graphs with two complete vertices
record.statement: The forcing conjecture holds for every bipartite graph $H$ which has two vertices in one part complete to the other part, which has at least two vertices.

record.title: Right-convergence of sparse Erdős–Rényi graphs
record.statement:
For every fixed $c>0$, does the sequence of sparse Erdős–Rényi graphs $G(n,c/n)$ right-converge with high probability; that is, for every finite weighted graph $H$ with a symmetric nonnegative weight matrix $w$, does
\[
\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{1}{n}\log h\bigl(G(n,c/n),H\bigr)
\]
exist with high probability, where $h(G,H)$ is the weighted homomorphism sum defined in the report?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4791), page 43. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Euclidean Ramsey conjecture for spherical finite configurations
record.statement: For every finite point set $K$ that can be embedded in a sphere and every positive integer $r$, does there exist an integer $d_0(K,r)$ such that, for every integer $d\ge d_0(K,r)$, every $r$-coloring of the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^d$ contains a monochromatic isometric copy of $K$?

record.title: Weak selections and weak orderability
record.statement: Is every topological space which admits a weak selection weakly orderable? Here a weak selection on a topological space $X$ is a continuous function $\[${X}^{2}$\]$ to $X$ such that $\[\varphi(x,y)=\varphi(y,x)\in\{x,y\}\]$ for every $x,y\in X$, and $X$ is weakly orderable if it admits a weaker linearly ordered topology.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/02](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4792), page 18. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Classification under weaker assumptions than Maharam’s theorem
record.statement: Can a characterization analogous to Maharam’s classification be obtained for pairs $(B,\mu)$ in which $B$ is an arbitrary Boolean algebra, not necessarily $\sigma$-complete, and $\mu$ is a strictly positive finitely additive measure on $B$, normalized so that $\mu(1_B)=1$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/02](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4792), page 19. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Mazur’s rotation problem
record.statement: Any separable Banach space $X$ whose norm is transitive—that is, for every two points $x,y$ on the unit sphere of $X$, there exists a surjective linear isometry $T:X\to X$ such that $Tx=y$—is isometric to $\ell_2$.

record.title: Bárány–Larman conjecture for the alternative colored Tverberg function
record.statement:
Let $t(d,r)$ be the function defined in the report’s alternative colored Tverberg problem. The Bárány–Larman conjecture asserts that
\[
t(d,r)=r\qquad\text{for all integers }d\ge 1\text{ and }r\ge 2.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/08](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4798), page 12. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: False Grassmannian bundle conjecture for symmetric powers
record.statement: Suppose $d$ and $k$ are even positive integers. Then there exists $n(d,k)$ such that, for every section of the bundle $\Sigma^d(\gamma_n^k)$ over $G_n^k$, with $n\ge n(d,k)$, there exists a subspace $V\in G_n^k$ such that this section is a multiple of $(Q(\gamma_n^k))^{d/2}$ over $V$.

record.title: Gromov–Milman conjecture for homogeneous polynomials
record.statement: For every even positive integer $d$ and every positive integer $k$, there exists an integer $n(d,k)$ such that, for every homogeneous polynomial $f$ of degree $d$ on $\fR^n$ with $n\ge n(d,k)$, there is a linear $k$-dimensional subspace $V\subseteq\u0007fR^n$ for which $f|_V$ is proportional to the $d/2$-th power of the standard quadratic form $Q=x_1^2+x_2^2+\cdots+x_n^2$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/08](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4798), page 25. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Lower bound for the second h-number of a simplicial cell decomposition of the 3-torus
record.statement: Prove that if $P$ is a simplicial cell decomposition of the 3-dimensional torus $T^3=S^1\times S^1\times S^1$, then $h_2(P)\ge 22$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/08](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4798), page 50. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Quantization commutes with reduction for proper cocompact actions
record.statement:
Under the hypotheses of the Hochs–Landsman conjecture, there exists a positive integer $p_0$ such that, for every integer $p\ge p_0$,
\[
\left(\int_G\right)^*\!\circ\mu_M^G\bigl([\eth_M^{L^p}]\bigr)=\operatorname{index}\bigl(\eth_{M_G}^{L_G^p}\bigr).
\]
If $G$ has an $\operatorname{Ad}$-invariant metric, one may take $p_0=1$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/09](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4799), page 55. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Positivity conjecture for refined Donaldson–Thomas invariants
record.statement: Assume that $Q$ is a symmetric quiver. For every stability parameter $\theta\in\mathbb{R}^{Q_0}$ and every $\alpha\in\mathbb{N}^{Q_0}$, the function $\Omega^\theta_\alpha(-q^{1/2})$ is a Laurent polynomial in $q^{1/2}$ with non-negative integer coefficients; equivalently, $\Omega^\theta_\alpha(-q^{1/2})\in\mathbb{N}[q^{\pm 1/2}]$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/10](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4800), page 50. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Generic basis conjecture beyond the Buan–Iyama–Reiten–Scott setting
record.statement:
The authors of [11] conjecture that the set
\[
\left\{x_e\psi_Z\ \middle|\ Z\text{ is strongly reduced},\ e\in\mathbb N^{Q_0},\ \operatorname{supp}(e)\cap\operatorname{supp}(\dim Z)=\varnothing\right\}
\]
is a basis of the associated cluster algebra \(A_Q\) even outside the setting of Example 2.

record.title: Indecomposable tree modules for every root
record.statement: Let $k=\\mathbb{C}$ and let $Q=(Q_0,Q_1)$ be a quiver without oriented cycles. Does there exist an indecomposable tree module for every root $d\in\mathbb{N}^{Q_0}$?

record.title: Computational interpretation of all the axioms
record.statement: The report conjectures that a computational interpretation of all the axioms is possible, defining equality on a type by recursion on that type, extending Gandy’s 1956 definition for simple type theory. For this interpretation, it expects the equality $\operatorname{Id}_{B(a)}(b\mathbin{\cdot}1_a)\,b$ to hold only as a propositional equality and not as a definitional equality.

record.title: Unique algorithm generating the 15 rows of Plimpton 322
record.statement: Are the 15 rows the result of a unique algorithm?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/12](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4802), page 25. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Kernel generation for the longest intertwining operator
record.statement:
Let \(\pi=L_Q(\delta_1,\ldots,\delta_k)\) be an arbitrary irreducible representation, and let \(K=\ker M(w_0)\) be the kernel of the longest intertwining operator, equivalently the kernel of the projection \(\delta_1\times\cdots\times\delta_k\to\pi\). Is it true in general that
\[
K=\sum_{w=w_1w_2:\,w_1\text{ a simple reflection},\,M_{w_2}\text{ an isomorphism}}\ker M_w?
\]

record.title: Wavelet-basis independence for leader scaling functions with finitely smooth wavelets
record.statement: For a bounded function $f$, does the leader scaling function $\[1m\eta_f(p)\u001b[0m$ remain independent of the choice of wavelet basis for every $p\in\mathbb{R}$ when the wavelets have only finite smoothness, for example when they are compactly supported?

record.title: Existence of a real rational plane quartic through 11 generic real points
record.statement: There exists a real rational plane quartic through 11 generic real points.

record.title: Centers of centralizer algebras for symmetric groups
record.statement: Let $S_l\leq S_n$ be the subgroup of permutations fixing every number larger than $l$, and write $\mathbb{Z}S_n^{S_l}=\{a\in\mathbb{Z}S_n:ah=ha\ \text{for all }h\in S_l\}$. Is $Z(\mathbb{Z}S_n^{S_l})$ generated, as a $\mathbb{Z}$-algebra, by $Z(\mathbb{Z}S_n)$ and $Z(\mathbb{Z}S_l)$?

record.title: Hill’s conjecture on invariant factors of Cartan matrices of Hecke-algebra blocks
record.statement: For \(\ell=p^r\), Hill computed the invariant factors of the Cartan matrix associated with an individual block of the Iwahori–Hecke algebra \(H_n\) when \(r\le p\), and conjectured that the same formula holds for arbitrary \(r\).

record.title: Existence of ordinary-character basic sets
record.statement: For every finite group $G$ and prime $p$, does there exist a basic set $BS$ contained in $\operatorname{Irr}(G)$? record.title: Foulkes’ Conjecture
record.statement: For $m,n\in\mathbb{N}$ with $m<n$, let $H^{(m^n)}$ be the permutation module for $S_{mn}$ acting on set partitions of a set of size $mn$ into $n$ sets of size $m$, and let $\phi^{(m^n)}$ be its character. Foulkes conjectured that, for every irreducible character $\chi^\lambda$ of $S_{mn}$, $\langle \phi^{(m^n)},\chi^\lambda\rangle\geq \langle \phi^{(n^m)},\chi^\lambda\rangle$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/5149), page 18. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Thin-shell concentration conjecture of Anttila, Ball, and Perissinaki
record.statement: There exists a sequence $(\varepsilon_n)$ with $\varepsilon_n\to 0$ as $n\to\infty$ such that, for every isotropic log-concave random vector $X$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$, $$\mathbb{P}\left(\left||X|_2-\sqrt{n}\right|\geq\varepsilon_n\sqrt{n}\right)\leq\varepsilon_n.$$

record.title: Compressed-sensing recovery from a kernel-diameter condition
record.statement:
Let $0<r\le p<\infty$, let $A\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times N}$, and let $1\le m\le N$. Writing $q$ so that $\frac1p+\frac1q=\frac1r$, if
\[
\operatorname{diam}_p\bigl(\ker A\cap B_N^r\bigr)<\frac{1}{2m^{1/q}},
\]
then $A$ satisfies the $\ell_r$-minimization problem for every $x\in\operatorname{sparse}(m)$; namely, $x$ is the unique solution of
\[
\min\{\lvert t\rvert_r^r:t\in\mathbb{R}^N,\ At=Ax\}.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/24](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/5152), page 53. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Linear growth of an entry in a random contingency table
record.statement: Suppose that $m=n$ and $R=C=(3n,n,\ldots,n)$. Let $D$ be chosen uniformly at random from $A_+(R,C)$, the set of $n\times n$ matrices with non-negative integer entries and row sums $R$ and column sums $C$. Is it true that the expectation of the $(1,1)$ entry of $D$ grows linearly in $n$ as $n$ grows?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/24](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/5152), page 67. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Universal diffusion exponent for the wind-tree model
record.statement: For every $(a,b)\in(0,1)^2$, for almost every direction $\theta$ and every point $x\in T(a,b)$ with an infinite trajectory, $$\limsup_{t\to\infty}\frac{\log d\bigl(x,\phi_t^\theta(x)\bigr)}{\log t}=\frac{2}{3}.$$

record.title: Pure periodicity versus torus branched coverings
record.statement: Does pure periodicity imply that a translation surface is a torus branched covering? Here, a translation surface is purely periodic if, for every direction $\theta\in S^1$, the existence of a nonsingular periodic orbit in direction $\theta$ implies that the directional flow $\varphi_\theta$ is periodic, i.e. there exists $t>0$ such that $\varphi_\theta^t=\operatorname{Id}$ almost everywhere.

record.title: Hilbert modular varieties and the Schottky locus
record.statement: Conjecture: For every sufficiently large genus $g$, all but finitely many Hilbert modular varieties in $\mathcal A_g$ are disjoint from the Schottky locus $t(\mathcal M_g)$.

record.title: Semisimplicity of the division closure for groups with bounded torsion
record.statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a group whose finite subgroups have uniformly bounded orders, and let $D_\Gamma$ be the division closure of $\mathbb{Z}\Gamma$ in the algebra $U_\Gamma$ of affiliated operators. Is $D_\Gamma$ a semisimple Artinian ring, equivalently a direct sum of matrix rings over skew fields?

record.title: Vanishing theorem for negative K-groups and K-regularity
record.statement: Let $X$ be a scheme of finite type over a field $F$ of characteristic $0$, and suppose that the dimension of $X$ is $d$. Then $NK_i(X)=0$ for all $d\le -i$, and, in fact, $X$ is $K_{-d}$-regular. Moreover, $K_i(X)=0$ for $i<-d$, and $K_{-d}(X)$ can be computed explicitly in terms of a resolution of the singularities of $X$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/27](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/5155), page 23. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Hypothesis A on the Euler and Pontryagin classes of $B\mathrm{STOP}(2m)$

record.title: Hypothesis B on smooth maps to the plane

record.title: Beilinson’s non-degeneracy conjecture for Chow groups
record.statement:
For all smooth and proper schemes $X$ over a finite field, the intersection pairing
$$CH^{n}(X)_{\mathbb{Q}}\times CH_{n}(X)_{\mathbb{Q}}\longrightarrow CH_{0}(X)\longrightarrow \mathbb{Q}$$

record.title: Uniqueness of the Brownian map
record.statement: Can different subsequential Gromov–Hausdorff limits of rescaled uniformly distributed rooted planar $q$-angulations, or different admissible values of $q$ (namely $q=3$ or even $q\ge 4$), yield different limiting metric spaces? record.title: McCallum–Sharifi generation conjecture
record.statement:
For every odd prime $p$ and every integer $r\ge 1$, let $A_r=\operatorname{Cl}(\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_{p^r}))\{p\}$ and let $A_r^{-}$ be its minus part under complex conjugation. Then $A_r^{-}/p^rA_r^{-}$ is generated by the elements
\[
\{1-\zeta_{p^r}^{u},\,1-\zeta_{p^r}^{v}\},\qquad u,v\in\mathbb{Z}/p^r\mathbb{Z}\setminus\{0\},
\]
where the braces denote the stated cup-product pairing.
